accountId.description: Configured provider account used for owner-reviewed sends.

recipient.description: Exact owner-approved destination. Empty means external delivery is not configured.

level.description: silent: nothing leaves Friday, held items are only listed in the dashboard and summarized afterwards. voice_off: the voice stays quiet, but items of the important classes are sent as text to the owner's own registered messenger target. Default: "silent".

summaryAt.description: When the summary of the night is spoken: at the end time or with the first conversation in the morning. Default: "first_interaction".

quietMode.description: Defaults for a temporary quiet mode started by voice or dashboard.

level.description: silent: nothing leaves Friday, held items are only listed in the dashboard and summarized afterwards. voice_off: the voice stays quiet, but items of the important classes are sent as text to the owner's own registered messenger target. Default: "silent".

importantClasses.description: Classes that count as important while quiet with level voice_off. Default: ["agent_questions", "approvals"].

quietTextTargetId.description: Registered messenger target (the owner's own recipient) for voice_off texts; null sends nothing. Default: null.
